storyScreens.title: A World of Choices
storyScreens.content:
In this realm, your destiny is not written in the stars—it is forged in the choices you make before your journey even begins.

Every scar tells a story. Every skill was hard-won. Every belief shapes how the world sees you.

The character you create will face trials befitting their fate. Choose power, and the universe will test you. Choose humility, and find peace in simpler struggles.

storyScreens.title: The Fate Mechanic
storyScreens.content:
**Fate** measures how much destiny has invested in you.

Take powerful abilities and fortune smiles—but so do ancient evils, eager to test the worthy.

Embrace flaws and limitations, and fate looks elsewhere. Your path may be quieter, but no less meaningful.

There is no wrong choice. Only *your* choice.
